Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.schema

Class ApiResourceQuickFilterResolver

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.schema.ApiResourceQuickFilterResolver
@Component public class ApiResourceQuickFilterResolver extends Object
Resolve, valida e normaliza os filtros rapidos canonicos declarados via ApiResource.quickFilters() e AbstractResourceQueryController.defineQuickFilters(), aplicando coercao deterministica guiada pelo GenericFilterDTO do recurso.
